title: superseded
description: A run or branch was replaced for the same issue; run_id names the old run. Run-scoped: never a stage, ends nothing, releases no claim. Written by: callum-flow-regate; the factory loop (a fixer's new branch); the orchestrator and judge skills. Applied after the envelope by event.schema.json.

run_id.description: The run being replaced (required; may be "unknown").

branch.description: The replacing branch, when callum-flow-regate logs it.

note.description: For people: by <new branch> or re-gate on <branch>. No reader parses it.
